native_ownership.responsibility: Implement interactive data grids with deterministic server queries, selection and snapshot semantics, inline edits, batch actions, secure export, and accessible interaction.
excludes: Dashboard composition and analytical reporting are owned by reporting-dashboards.
Broad accessibility remediation is owned by accessibility-implement.
Generic page and component work is owned by frontend-implement.

risk.rationale: datagrid-patterns changes repository code and browser/server behavior; mutations remain limited to the explicitly requested scope and require affected-path verification.

positive.prompt: Implement a virtualized operations grid with server sorting/filtering, selection across pages, query-wide batch action, frozen snapshot semantics, row-version conflicts, per-row authorization, progress and partial-failure recovery.

Add an authorized CSV export and inline edits to a large tenant data table. The export must prevent spreadsheet formula execution, preserve a consistent dataset snapshot, and expose accessible native-table or ARIA-grid semantics intentionally.

negative.prompt: Build an executive analytics dashboard with KPI definitions, aggregate queries, chart composition, time-range comparisons, drill-downs, freshness labels and reporting performance.
Audit and repair keyboard navigation, landmarks, accessible names, focus management, live regions, contrast and screen-reader behavior across the whole frontend.

scenarios.prompt: A virtualized tenant grid selects rows by visible index, means 'all current matches' without a snapshot, authorizes only the batch endpoint globally, retries the entire batch after partial timeout, and exports quoted user values directly to CSV. Repair the contracts.

assertions.criterion: Implements grid query, selection, editing, batch, export and widget semantics without implementing or claiming ownership of dashboards or a broad accessibility program.
Inspects grid library, API/query contract, stable row identity/version, authorization rules, dataset scale, export consumers, browser targets and tests from the fixture.

Chooses native table versus composite grid when the task establishes the interaction model; otherwise states the missing interaction evidence and exact decision rule. In either case it defines deterministic query and snapshot/selection semantics, then edit, batch and export failure behavior before UI APIs.

Uses stable IDs and versions, freezes query-wide operations to an authoritative snapshot, authorizes each row/action, returns nonleaking partial outcomes and neutralizes spreadsheet formula/control input by a documented consumer policy.

Tests inserts/deletes during pagination, snapshot expiry, permission changes, mixed row outcomes, cancel/retry, timeout after commit, edit conflicts, virtualized focus and formula/newline/Unicode export cases.
Reports query/snapshot/selection contracts, per-row authorization, batch failure model, export policy, semantic choice, test evidence and residual scale/consumer risk.
Separates server data semantics from library rendering and avoids fixed page sizes, chunk sizes or ARIA behavior unsupported by repository requirements.

scenarios.prompt: An admin asks to run 'select all matching' delete from the browser after a long-lived filter session and to retry every row if the progress request times out. Permissions may have changed. Explain safe execution.

assertions.criterion: Stops until exact tenant, normalized query, authoritative snapshot, actor permission, operation identity, destructive confirmation, batch policy and recovery boundary are verified.
Reauthorizes each row at execution, uses concurrency/version checks, preserves per-row terminal outcomes and does not retry rows already durably accepted.
Requires persisted per-row outcomes, audit evidence, snapshot accounting and caller-visible reconciliation rather than browser progress or request success alone.

scenarios.prompt: The existing grid library is pinned to a supported release whose virtualization and accessibility APIs differ from the newest documentation. No dependency upgrade is authorized.

assertions.criterion: Uses lockfile, installed types, generated DOM behavior and matching official library documentation, with an explicit capability fallback and separate migration scope.
Checks framework adapter, grid core, browser support, server query contract and test harness together before selecting APIs.
Keeps native HTML and ARIA semantics based on current W3C guidance while isolating volatile library API details at the implementation boundary.
